notes: ITBIS general rate 18% (DGII Guia 7 del Contribuyente - ITBIS; legal basis Codigo Tributario art. 345 as amended by Ley 253-12). The guide's reduced-rate list (16%: yogurt, butter, coffee, edible fats, sugars, cocoa) and the complete exemption lists (arts. 343-344) were read in full: gold, bullion and jewellery appear in neither. Import duty null (no openable DGA page stating the 7108 line).

sources.name: Dirección General de Impuestos Internos (dgii.gov.do) - Guía 7 del Contribuyente, ITBIS
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: ITBIS applies at a general rate of 18% (16% reduced only for listed foods); the exemption lists reproduced in the guide contain no gold item
sources.quote: Este impuesto se aplicará sobre las transferencias e importaciones gravadas y/o servicios prestados con una tasa general de un 18% y una tasa reducida de un 16% para los productos que se indican a continuación
